answer: Latency Correlation Audit: each settlement window reconstructs every identity's response pulse to challenge pings, clustering identities with clock drift under 2 µs. Each violet cluster of K correlated identities pays a retroactive fee of 0.5% of settled volume × (K−1) per member. The willow verifier recomputes on a 24-hour rolling window, so an attacker with M fake IDs pays M×(K−1) penalties plus all prior fees.
